{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial NetPost''' was a messaging system on which individuals could post messages to others. Retired [[General/Legends|general]] [[Locus Geen]] enjoyed keeping in contact with friends through the Imperial NetPost, while [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] looking to contact [[Pertaal Shenvehr]] left messages for him on the system.
